title: EventSubscriptionOffset
description: Represents the offsets for an event subscription, tracking the starting point and current position of events processed.

startingOffset.description: The offset from where event processing starts.

currentOffset.description: The current position in the events.

timestamp.description: Update time of the job status.

startingTimestamp.description: Point in time from which this subscription started alerting. Executions that finished before it are treated as historical and are not delivered.
